highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.0 stabilizes the v3 line with WebAssembly improvements, updated platform support, and the modernized API surface.
highlights_body: It rolls up the v3 previews, including newer Skia and native dependencies, expanded view controls, and compatibility work for current .NET workloads.

breaking.title: Legacy APIs and platform integrations changed in v3
breaking.body: This stable release includes the v3 API cleanup and platform package updates from the preview line. Replace obsolete APIs and verify package references and target frameworks before upgrading.

bullets.detail: The stable v3 line includes the Skia m116 update and refreshed bundled graphics and text dependencies.
Adds span-based point operations, SKBlender, animation support, and additional picture and shader APIs.
Adds multithreaded and SIMD WebAssembly support and resolves Blazor base-path and .NET 9 runtime issues.
